ValidationRule.description: A decision date is required once a credit decision has been made.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Conditionally Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Declined"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked")), ISBLANK(Decision_Date__c))
